title: CytoVI: deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell data
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03224-5 CytoVI is a deep generative model for statistically rigorous analysis of antibody-based single-cell data.

title: Spatially resolved chromatin architectures in mammalian brain tissues
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03218-3 Spatial Hi-C allows the study of chromatin organization in a spatially resolved manner. This approach shows regional and cell-type-specific differences in the adult and developing mouse brain.

title: Control of ice thickness in cryo-EM via confinement
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03244-1 This study explores the use of graphene reservoirs formed over perforated supporting films as a method to precisely control ice thickness during cryo-EM sample preparation.

title: NanoTS: a deep learning tool for accurate SNP calling in nanopore long-read transcriptome data
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 22 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03225-4 NanoTS facilitates nanopore long-read transcriptome sequencing based SNP detection and genotype calling using deep learning.

title: SVPG: a pangenome-based structural variant detection approach and rapid augmentation of pangenome graphs with new samples
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 21 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03219-2 SVPG performs accurate pangenome-facilitated structural variant detection and accelerates pangenome graph augmentation using long-read sequencing data.

title: When a laser beam hits an electron beam
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03239-y Prototypes of specially engineered transmission electron microscopes deliver images with greatly improved contrast to cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) projects.
